card.name: Words just before risk or amount terms
card.fires_on: Marked words in warning text that lead into a risk or amount phrase, such as "receive" before parenteral aluminum levels, "the" after "increases" before "risk", and "large" before "amounts". It also fires on the start of aminoglycoside names like PAR in PAROMOMYCIN.

modes.label: Verb or article before risk/amount
modes.description: A verb, article or adjective that sets up a risk or quantity phrase in a warning.
modes.example: Antidepressants increased<< the>> risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric

modes.label: Start of antibiotic name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name in an all-caps list of aminoglycosides and related antibiotics.

card.plain: It fires on small words in warnings that come right before a phrase about risk or amount, and on the start of some antibiotic names.
